detail.longDescription:
Manage your N8N agents, workflows, credentials and much more. Take n8n.io anywhere you go with Nathan!

◆ WORKFLOWS
- View Workflow Info
- Activate Workflow
- Deactivate Workflow
- Edit Workflow Tags
- Change Workflow Settings
- Rename Workflow
- Remove Workflow

◆ CREDENTIALS
- Browse All Credentials
- View Credential Info
- Edit Credential
- Remove Credential

◆ EXECUTIONS
- Browse All Executions
- View Execution Info
- Check Execution Logs

◆ INSIGHTS
- View Total Executions
- View Failed Executions
- View Average Execution Time


That’s it folks!

This text isn't gonna get any more interesting. I mean, I think we've pretty much covered all the good stuff. Still here? Ummmm, ok. How's everything? Good? Cool cool cool. 

What are you looking for? The app description is over. For real, check out the app. It's way better than hanging out in the App Store this long.

Wow, you're dedicated. Do you just love app descriptions? Weird. OK, we're gonna go now. Bye.


NOTICE & ACKNOWLEDGMENT
1. Authentication data is stored locally on your device, and never leaves it.
2. Nathan is OSS (Open Source Software), feel free to open an Issue or PR at github.com/get-nathan/nathan
3. This is not a replacement for the N8N website. Certain actions, such as creating new workflows, should be done directly in the web editor.
